title: Job last-run record
description: What one scheduled job left behind on its host: the shared writer (role last_run, hnx-last-run) rewrites it when the job's service starts (running) and again when it stops, whatever the outcome (systemd ExecStopPost, SERVICE_RESULT/EXIT_CODE/EXIT_STATUS). It carries the schedule the host actually runs, so the status hub's job-last-run mapping can tell a late job from an idle one without the repository. One file per job per host, mode 0640, named after the job id. Evolve additively.

job.description: The job's id on the Schedule page: timer:<role>/<unit> for a role or profile timer, fleet-unit:<name> for a fleet unit.

unit.description: The systemd service the timer starts.

host.description: The short host name the job ran on.

on_calendar.description: The timer's OnCalendar= value as rendered on the host.

randomized_delay_s.description: The timer's RandomizedDelaySec= in seconds (absent: none).

running.description: true from the start until the service stops.

result.description: systemd's SERVICE_RESULT: success, exit-code, signal, timeout, core-dump, watchdog, ...

exit_code.description: systemd's EXIT_CODE: exited, killed or dumped.

exit_status.description: systemd's EXIT_STATUS: the exit status, or the signal name.
